Definition: Lachmam or Lachmas, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Lahmam appears once, in the list of the cities of Judah in Joshua 15:40. It was a town in the lowland of Judah, given to the tribe in the division of the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the one-line town still belongs in the record: the land was divided town by town, and God kept the list.
